title: Bugatti CEO to stop leaving keys inside cars after Chiron theft
summary: The Croatian CEO of Bugatti vowed on Thursday to stop leaving keys inside cars after his multi-million-dollar Chiron was stolen and recovered in Austria with him chasing the thief in a Porsche.
